name: study_shadow_http_probe_plan
purpose: Define the future authenticated HTTP comparison plan between existing Study behavior and Universal Intent Router Study shadow output.
future_authenticated_probe_sequence: submit existing Study command request to current Study route
submit equivalent payload to Study shadow adapter helper
compare current Study route outcome with shadow router intent
record intent, confidence band, existing route, rule id, and safety flags
prove user-visible Study behavior is unchanged
keep dispatch disabled until a later explicit wiring stage
must_not_do: do not wire router into Study routes
do not mutate Study state through the router
do not alter frontend Study behavior
